channel.niche: Untold stories from Indian mythology and history, told as short cinematic films
channel.audience: Indians in India and abroad, 16-40, who love mythology, history and epic storytelling
channel.style: Epic, reverent and gripping, like a movie trailer narrated by a calm storyteller. Simple words.

profiles_note: Formats never mix: each has its own channel text (channels), voice (voices), colours (video.theme_presets), topic queue (ideas_<format>.csv), output folder (out/<format>/) and YouTube channel (secrets/token_<format>.json). video.format is the preferred format; stickman is used when Flow credits run out.

content_rules: Never show the face of Krishna, Shiva or any deity: show divine figures only from behind, as silhouettes in golden light, or through symbols (peacock feather, flute, chakra, trident).
No gore: never show killing, beheading or blood on screen; imply it with cutaways, shadows or symbols.
Be respectful: these are sacred stories for many viewers. No mockery, no modern slang.
cinematic.accounts_note: Credits are tracked per Google account in state/credits.json; a film is made if ANY account can afford it.

stickman.niche: Stick-figure stories that answer 'why' and 'how' questions about history, science and everyday things
stickman.audience: Curious people in India and worldwide, 15-35, who like learning through stories
stickman.style: Story first, facts second. Warm, simple, a little funny. One question per video.
stickman.cta: Follow for more stories of how things began.

llm.note: Claude = master (scripts, fact-checks, timely topics). Local Ollama model = worker (repetitive jobs). Task values: claude, claude:<sonnet|opus|haiku>, local, local:<ollama model>.
